_note: JFL reports a single Ind AS 108 segment (food and beverages) and a secondary geographic split (sales within / outside India, AR note 43). We model two parts. India = sales within India (Domino's India, Popeyes, Hong's Kitchen; Dunkin' re-presented as discontinued from FY25) with EBITDA = standalone EBITDA. International = sales outside India (DP Eurasia: Turkey, Azerbaijan, Georgia, consolidated from 1-Feb-2024; Sri Lanka; Bangladesh) with EBITDA = consolidated less standalone (includes consolidation adjustments and, for DP Eurasia, the IAS 29 monetary gain/loss). FY23-FY24 India is the standalone revenue incl. Dunkin' (not re-presented) and FY24 International holds two months of DP Eurasia. EBITDA here is after Ind AS 116 (rent excluded) on the company's basis; Screener's FY26 EBITDA is Rs14 cr higher (it shows the Rs14.4 cr loss on store discards below EBITDA).
